evals.prompt: Sketch a simple login wireframe: email field, password field, and a primary Login button. Save it under sketches/.
evals.expected_output: A valid sketches/<name>.excalidraw file with rectangle+text elements for the fields and button, no MCP or canvas server used; user told the path; agent launches excalidraw-offline <path> when available (or explains how to open).

evals.prompt: Draw an architecture diagram with Client → API → Postgres as labeled boxes and arrows. Put it in sketches/api-flow.excalidraw.
evals.expected_output: sketches/api-flow.excalidraw exists with three nodes, bound or free-standing labels, and arrows with startBinding/endBinding. No mcp-excalidraw-server or MCP tools invoked.

evals.prompt: Create a CAD object sketch of a small enclosure: front outline, four mounting holes, and a callout for M4 screws. Then update the sketch to add a side-view outline.
evals.expected_output: One .excalidraw under sketches/ created then updated in place (CRUD), with view labels and feature callouts; agent notes exact dims belong in FreeCAD/ForgeCAD.

evals.prompt: List sketches in the workspace, open an existing sketches/smoke-test.excalidraw if present (or create it), add a title text 'Smoke', and confirm the file still validates as type=excalidraw version=2.
evals.expected_output: File-backed read/update only under sketches/; document still has type, version, elements, appState, files; no Obsidian .excalidraw.md and no canvas server.

evals.prompt: Delete the sketch sketches/tmp-delete-me.excalidraw after creating a throwaway one with that name.
evals.expected_output: Create then delete under sketches/; leftover assets cleaned if any; no git commit unless asked.
